query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS board_decisions (
  id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  venture_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  venture_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  decision_title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  decision_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'General',
  description TEXT,
  rationale TEXT,
  mission_alignment_score INT DEFAULT 0,
  financial_impact VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'None',
  strategic_impact VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'None',
  decision_date DATE NOT NULL,
  decision_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pending',
  votes_for INT DEFAULT 0,
  votes_against INT DEFAULT 0,
  votes_abstain INT DEFAULT 0,
  total_board_members INT DEFAULT 0,
  quorum_met BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  proposed_by VARCHAR(255),
  approved_by VARCHAR(255),
  implementation_deadline DATE,
  implementation_status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'Not Started',
  notes TEXT,
  tags VARCHAR(500),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
